# ECN-2026-007 - Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

## Reason for change
This engineering change updates the specified main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) and aligns maintenance practice and records with inspection findings and supplier recommendations. During a recent inspection and teardown referenced in maintenance records, evidence of bolt relaxation and uneven clamping of the main ram assembly was identified. The change is intended to restore and maintain clamp load uniformity, reduce fretting and wear at the ram-to-housing interface, and mitigate risk of ram misalignment that can lead to premature component failure or safety hazards.

Root-cause analysis found that prior torque practice and documentation were inconsistent with the fastener specification and the press manufacturer’s guidelines. This ECN consolidates the torque requirement into the controlled documentation set and updates work instructions and maintenance checks to ensure reproducible application of the specified clamp load.

The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m.

Related documents: MM-P1-L4-HP02, SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-05

## Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02 (Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2).  
- Maintenance procedures: SOP-P1-L4-05 (work instruction updates required to reflect new torque value).  
- Maintenance history and asset records: MM-P1-L4-HP02 (to be updated to capture torque application and verification entries).  
- Service bulletin: SB-1034 (incorporate applicable inspection findings and recommendations into routine checks).

Affected components and records to be revised:
- Main ram bolt torque specification in the EQ-P1-L4-HP02 equipment file. Include torque application method and verification acceptance criteria.
- SOP-P1-L4-05: revise step sequence for main ram removal/installation to require torque verification and a specified verification record.
- MM-P1-L4-HP02: create a maintenance log entry template for torque application and verification sign-off.
- Training records for technicians performing ram bolt torque application: update to include competency check against the revised SOP.

Note: This ECN does not change hydraulic pressures, operational setpoints, or component part numbers. See SB-1034 for historical inspection detail and MM-P1-L4-HP02 for original maintenance context.

## Implementation
Summary: Apply the specified torque value to the main ram bolt on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 and revise controlled documents and records to ensure repeatable application and traceability.

Implementation steps (high level):
- Document update: Revise SOP-P1-L4-05 to include the torque value and associated verification steps. Add a required signature block and reference to MM-P1-L4-HP02 for record retention. Cross-reference SB-1034 for inspection checkpoints.
- Tooling and method: Use a calibrated torque tool appropriate for the required torque range and fastening geometry. Calibrate torque tools according to the calibration schedule documented in MM-P1-L4-HP02. Record serial numbers of tools used in maintenance logs.
- Procedure for torque application:
  - Prepare the main ram assembly per SOP-P1-L4-05 revision. Clean mating surfaces and threads, inspect fastener condition, and replace any fasteners showing damage. Apply torque following the sequence specified in SOP-P1-L4-05.
  - Apply the main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m.
  - Verify applied torque using independent verification method (secondary torque tool or torque verification witness). Document verification in MM-P1-L4-HP02 maintenance entry.
- Records to keep:
  - Completed SOP-P1-L4-05 checklist with technician and supervisor signatures.
  - MM-P1-L4-HP02 maintenance entry with torque value, tool identifier, verifier signature, and any observations.
  - Calibration certificate reference for the torque tool used (attach or reference in MM-P1-L4-HP02).
  - Any deviation reports and follow-up corrective actions if achieved torque differs from the specified value.
- Training:
  - All technicians performing main ram work on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 must complete the updated SOP-P1-L4-05 training and demonstrate competency. Document training completion in personnel records and in MM-P1-L4-HP02.
- Example entries (for illustrative style; exact form to be placed into MM-P1-L4-HP02):
  - Tool ID: [tool serial]; Applied torque: 970 N·m; Verifier: [name]; Notes: [inspection observations]
  - Calibration certificate: [ref]; SOP revision used: SOP-P1-L4-05 Rev B; Maintenance record link: MM-P1-L4-HP02

Quality control and verification:
- After torque application, perform a follow-up inspection per SB-1034 checkpoints to confirm ram alignment and absence of fretting or movement under static load.
- Maintain records in MM-P1-L4-HP02 and make them available for engineering review and audits.

## Approvals
- Engineering approval: Required to accept the change into the equipment file. Engineering will review revisions to SOP-P1-L4-05 and MM-P1-L4-HP02 entries for conformance.
- Maintenance approval: Maintenance management to confirm readiness of personnel, calibration status of torque tools, and ability to implement the revised procedure on EQ-P1-L4-HP02.
- Safety review: Safety representative to confirm the implementation method does not introduce new hazards and that required lockout/tagout and guarding practices are followed during the procedure.

Approval signatures shall be recorded on the ECN form and attached to the SOP-P1-L4-05 revision package. Retain completed ECN, updated SOP-P1-L4-05, updated MM-P1-L4-HP02 entries, and any referenced SB-1034 inspection notes in the document control system archive.

Related documents: MM-P1-L4-HP02, SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-05

Notes:
- Implement this change only on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 as specified in this ECN. If similar upgrades are proposed for other presses, initiate separate ECN actions referencing the approach and lessons learned from this implementation.
- Maintain traceability between ECN-2026-007 Rev B, the revised SOP, and the maintenance records for future audits and failure investigations.
